arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 6000 m, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Calib CP shaft 161 W, Wprime 17.1 kJ; boat CP 109 W. Even-ish target: shaft about CP + Wprime/race time = 161 + 17100/1700 = about 171 W, reserve to empty near finish. Start was hot (254 W shaft at min 1, pod reserve 67 pct). Watch for: rudder weed (push_local drop with steady pod power), current changes, wrong CP (reserve vs feel), wrong distance.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; strongly negative = something new slowing the boat (weed on rudder, current change)

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: check rudder weed or current change

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.12 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and elapsed_s > 150 and remaining_m > 800
shaft_power_w < 0.9 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and elapsed_s > 150 and remaining_m > 600

arguments.message: 900 m to go: plan the finish

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into race rhythm, long strokes.

Min 1.2: cued ease (settle). Set derived drag_gap = push_local_mps - push_along_mps and watches: drag_drop (drag_gap < -0.2 for 25 s: weed/current), over_pace (shaft > 1.12x sustainable 45 s), under_pace (shaft < 0.9x sustainable 60 s), finish_zone (remaining < 900 m). No pace targets: current flips each leg, ground-pace target would mislead.

text: Cued ease to settle the hot start (pod reserve 67 pct after 1 min); set watches for over/under pacing, drag drop and the finish.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Smooth and steady, long race ahead.

Min 3.4: still 192 W shaft vs sustainable 164, pod reserve 31 pct, boat reserve 30 pct. Cued ease again. Paddler says 7/10 plenty: maybe CP underestimated, or overconfident. Check: if they hold ~190 W for 10 min with no fade while reserve reads near 0, CP is higher (consider set_critical_power). Current pushes about +0.23 on leg 1 (north), expect against on return legs.

text: Cued ease again: 192 W shaft vs 164 sustainable with reserve at 31 pct; paddler feels fine (7/10), noted CP may be low.

arguments.text: Reserve nearly spent. Ease to steady, save it for the finish.

Min 6.4 (leg 2, south, current now against): paddler ignored ease at 3.3, held 185-193 W shaft for 4 min, GPS speed steady 3.39 on leg 1 (no real fade; -2.6 at turn is turn+lagging push). Pod reserve 1 pct, says 8/10 plenty. Cued ease #3. TEST: if shaft stays >= 180 W to min 11 with no fade and no blow-up, true CP is likely ~180+: set_critical_power cp_shaft ~180 (boat ~122). If shaft collapses below 150, that was a blow-up: hold them at ~155 to recover.

text: Cued ease: pod reserve at 1 pct while holding 185 W vs 161 CP; set a test to revise CP if they hold it without fading.

arguments.text: Too hot for now. Ease to 185 pace, bank it for later.

arguments.message: turned onto leg 3 (current helping): any ground-pace target set on leg 2 is now wrong, re-cue

arguments.text: Min 7.4: paddler surging (208 W shaft, says feeling great, going) with pod AND boat reserve at 0-2 pct; no fade yet (speed vs early 0 pct). Both reserve models agree so not pod drift. Cued ease #4 WITH ground pace 185 s/500 (about CP 161 W against -0.25 current). Pace target is leg-2 only: watch turn2_done fires after turn at 2500 m to re-cue (current then helps). If they still hold 200 W with no fade by min 10, CP is likely 190+: set_critical_power.

text: Cued ease to 185 s/500 (about CP against the current): paddler surging at 208 W with both reserve models empty; turn watch set to reset the target on leg 3.

arguments.text: Boat is dragging. Quick back-stroke to clear the rudder.

Min 8.8: drag_gap ramped 0 to -0.22 between min 7.1 and 8.2 (push_local -0.42 vs fit -0.19), GPS speed fell 2.93 to 2.77 while shaft rose 184 to 217 then 204 (my ease at 7.5 partly followed). speed vs early -5.9 pct. Paddler 8/10 plenty, no complaint. Hypotheses: rudder weed, stronger current, tired blade. Cued clear_rudder. CHECK: if drag_gap returns to about 0 within 30-60 s it was weed; if not, current or tired blade (turn at 2500 m will show: current would flip positive on leg 3).

text: Cued clear_rudder: boat 0.22 m/s slower than pod power predicts after a ramp starting min 7.1, possible weed; will check whether the gap closes.

arguments.message: boat power well above sustainable (boat model)
boat power well below sustainable (boat model)

arguments.text: Min 11.8: clear_rudder at 8.9 did little (push_local -0.38 to -0.33). Pod reads 205-221 W for 5 min with pod reserve 0 and NO blow-up; paddler 8/10 plenty. Boat model (GPS+fit+hull): boat power 105-114 W = CP 109, boat reserve 1-4 pct, steady. Shaft/boat ratio rose 1.5 to 1.9. Best story: POD READING HIGH (drift) or blade inefficiency; true effort about CP. Pace from BOAT model now, ignore pod numbers. Replaced pod watches with boat ones (over_pace_boat, under_pace_boat). After turn at 2500 m: if drag_gap stays about -0.15 on leg 3 too, it is pod drift or drag, not current.

text: no cue: boat model says pace is at critical power and steady; pod looks to read high, so switched pacing watches to the boat model.

arguments.message: 70 s into leg 3: compare GPS speed and push_local with leg 1 (3.39 m/s at 190 W pod, push +0.25) to tell current vs pod drift vs drag

text: no cue: just turned, the 185 target from leg 2 has faded; set a watch to compare leg 3 speed with leg 1 once the turn settles.

arguments.text: Min 14.7 CONFIRMED on leg 3 (current helping): pod 223 W but GPS 3.28 m/s vs leg 1 3.39 at pod 190; drag_gap -0.11 on this leg too, so NOT current. Real 220 W for 8 min on empty reserve impossible within 25 pct CP error, so POD READS HIGH (drift since about min 6.6). Use BOAT model only: boat power about 110-116 = CP 109, boat reserve 0, fade -2 to -3 pct. Paddler is at their limit: hold CP, no surges. Finish plan: reserve empty, so short sprint, cue finish at about 300-350 m to go (not earlier). Remaining legs: leg 3 with current, leg 4 against (1250 m), last 1000 m with.

arguments.message: 360 m to go: cue the finish sprint now

text: no cue: leg 3 confirms the pod reads high, boat model shows the paddler holding critical power on an empty reserve, which is right; finish watch set for 360 m out.

arguments.text: Yes, likely weed. Back-stroke now to clear the rudder.

arguments.message: about 45 s after the second clear_rudder: did speed through water recover from 2.73 to about 3.05?

arguments.text: Min 17.1: paddler said boat feels heavy all of a sudden, something on the rudder. Speed water fell 3.06 to 2.73 (fade -13 pct), boat power 113 to 79, pod 222 to 166. Cued clear_rudder #2 at 17.1. weed_check watch at 3340 m: if speed recovered, it was weed; if still slow and pod low, maybe a blow-up: ask paddler, then hold steady.

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports sudden heaviness and speed through water fell 11 pct; check set for 45 s later.

arguments.text: Min 17.9: STEP at min 16.3: speed water 3.04 to 2.65, boat power 112 to 74, pod 221 to 165, rate same 58, push_local only 0.08 to 0.01. Paddler 8/10 plenty but says boat heavy, rudder. No recovery 45 s after clear_rudder at 17.1 (maybe not followed). Retrying clear_rudder at about 18.0. If still 2.65 a minute later: weed not the cause or not clearing; then cue push (boat power 74 vs sustainable 112, boat reserve refilling 24 pct).
Still heavy. Firm back-stroke now, knock the weed off.
Still heavy. Firm back-stroke now, knock the weed off.

text: Re-cued clear_rudder: sudden 13 pct speed loss the paddler blames on the rudder did not recover after the first clear request.

arguments.message: speed through water below 2.8 at normal rate: weed again? (ignore if just after a turn)
on leg 4 (into the current): decide push and check weed cleared

arguments.text: Min 18.2: after clear_rudder #3 at 18.1 speed water recovering 2.65 to 2.94, pod 167 to 181, push_local 0.01 to 0.17: weed likely cleared. Paddler: I feel strong, let me go harder. Boat reserve 26 pct (partly fake: refilled while weed hid true power). Plan: no surge on this with-current leg; if wanted, put extra effort INTO the current on leg 4 (from 3750 m) but modest; finish sprint at 360 m. weed_again watch: speed_water < 2.8 for 25 s. Pod-based drag_gap did NOT catch the weed (pod fell with speed).

text: no cue (cooldown): speed recovering after the rudder clear; plan to spend any extra effort into the current on leg 4, watches set for weed and leg 4.

arguments.text: Min 18.4: escort radio: wind filling from the SOUTH 8-12 kn. So leg 3 and last leg (north) tailwind, leg 4 (south, 3750-5000 m) headwind + current against. Push fit lags the wind: on leg 4 boat power and reserve will read LOW (looks like refilling), on north legs HIGH. Plan: at leg 4 start cue push (most time gained per watt into wind); hold or ease slightly on last leg with tailwind until finish sprint at 360 m. Evidence suggests true CP a bit above 109 boat (held 112 for 10 min on empty, little fade).

text: no cue (cooldown, tailwind leg): noted southerly wind; will cue a push into the wind and current at the start of leg 4.

arguments.text: Weed is off. Into the wind now, push this leg.

Min 20.3: weed confirmed cleared (leg 3 after clear: speed water 3.06-3.19 at pod 208-219, same as before weed). Tailwind leg inflated boat power (130) so boat reserve fell to 10 pct, likely understated. Leg 4 into headwind + current (push_local -0.63): cued PUSH (no pace target). At 900 m to go (after last turn, tailwind): hold steady, finish sprint at 360 m. If paddler fades badly on leg 4, ease.

arguments.message: mid leg 4: check the push is holding without a blow-up

text: Cued push for leg 4: weed cleared and extra effort buys the most time into the headwind and current; mid-leg check set.
